signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: PINNED regime (Positive GEX $186M + VIX Contango +7.1%) forces dealers to buy dips and sell rips, compressing volatility and establishing a mean-reversion baseline. CAG indicates bear-delusion, providing a contrarian bullish edge. While aggregate options flow shows a bearish PC ratio (1.308) and $2.84B in puts, the positive GEX structure confirms this is portfolio hedging rather than directional selling. Deep ITM call premium on AAPL ($67.8M) and NVDA ($31.9M) validates institutional long bias. Backtested intraday accuracy is 100%, but MEDIUM tier next-day accuracy is only 50%, prompting a confidence cap of 50-55% and tight price targets (<=0.5% intraday, <=1.0% next-day). The primary driver is GEX, which dictates the mean-reversion strategy and bullish lean.
